import HartshorneLib.Chapter4HigherPoleResidueCompatibility
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.LinearPMap

/-!
# Residues on rational differentials for a specified parameter

Compatibility across finite pole bounds and exhaustion of rational
differentials extend the finite-pole residue to a linear map on all rational
differentials. The parameter remains explicit in this construction;
`Chapter4ResidueParameterChange` proves change-of-parameter invariance and
`Chapter4IntrinsicResidue` exposes the resulting intrinsic map.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The fixed-parameter residue at a finite pole level as a partial linear map. -/
def curveHigherPoleResiduePMap {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ) :
    CurveRationalDifferentials X →ₗ.[k] k :=
  ⟨(curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1)).restrictScalars k,
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht n⟩

theorem curveHigherPoleResiduePMap_monotone {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) : Monotone (curveHigherPoleResiduePMap X hx t ht) := by
  intro n m hnm
  refine ⟨curvePoleDifferentials_mono X (Nat.add_le_add_right hnm 1), ?_⟩
  intro ω η hωη
  change curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht n ω =
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht m η
  have hη : η = ⟨ω, curvePoleDifferentials_mono X
      (Nat.add_le_add_right hnm 1) ω.property⟩ := Subtype.ext hωη.symm
  rw [hη]
  exact (curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_mono X hx t ht hnm
    ⟨ω, ω.property⟩).symm

private theorem curveHigherPoleResiduePMap_directed {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) :
    DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (Set.range (curveHigherPoleResiduePMap X hx t ht)) :=
  (curveHigherPoleResiduePMap_monotone X hx t ht).directed_le.directedOn_range

/-- The compatible union of the fixed-parameter finite-pole residue maps. -/
def curveRationalDifferentialResiduePMap {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) : CurveRationalDifferentials X →ₗ.[k] k :=
  LinearPMap.sSup (Set.range (curveHigherPoleResiduePMap X hx t ht))
    (curveHigherPoleResiduePMap_directed X hx t ht)

theorem curveRationalDifferentialResiduePMap_domain {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) :
    (curveRationalDifferentialResiduePMap X hx t ht).domain = ⊤ := by
  apply top_unique
  intro ω _
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_curvePoleDifferentials X hx ω
  apply (LinearPMap.mem_domain_sSup_iff (Set.range_nonempty _)
    (curveHigherPoleResiduePMap_directed X hx t ht)).mpr
  exact ⟨curveHigherPoleResiduePMap X hx t ht n, Set.mem_range_self n,
    curvePoleDifferentials_mono X (Nat.le_succ n) hn⟩

/-- The residue of an arbitrary rational differential, computed using a
specified local parameter. -/
def curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : Irreducible t) : CurveRationalDifferentials X →ₗ[k] k :=
  (curveRationalDifferentialResiduePMap X hx t ht).toFun.comp
    (LinearEquiv.ofTop _ (curveRationalDifferentialResiduePMap_domain X hx t ht)).symm.toLinearMap

/-- On any finite pole lattice, the total map is the finite Taylor-coefficient
residue with the same specified parameter. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_higherPole
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ)
    (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1)) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht ω =
      curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht n ω := by
  exact LinearPMap.sSup_apply (curveHigherPoleResiduePMap_directed X hx t ht)
    (Set.mem_range_self n) ω

/-- For differentials with at most a simple pole, the total map agrees with
the intrinsic residue. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht ω =
      curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx ω := by
  rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_higherPole X hx t ht 0
    ⟨ω, (curvePoleDifferentials_one X x).symm ▸ ω.property⟩]
  exact curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_zero_eq_simplePole X hx t ht ω

/-- The fixed-parameter residue vanishes on regular differentials. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    {ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X}
    (hω : ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht ω = 0 := by
  have hs : ω ∈ curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x :=
    curveRegularDifferentialLattice_le_simplePole X x hω
  rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole X hx t ht ⟨ω, hs⟩]
  exact (curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_eq_zero_iff X hx ⟨ω, hs⟩).mpr hω

/-- Every scalar occurs as a residue already among simple-pole differentials. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_surjective
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    Function.Surjective (curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht) := by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_surjective X hx c
  exact ⟨ω, (curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole X hx t ht ω).trans hω⟩

end
end Hartshorne
